I've solved the task. I entered weighted-average formulas in J3:L6 of Sheet1.

For each FY in H3:H6, I computed the weighted average of %PLF DAY (column D), M/C Availability (E), and Grid Availability (F), where the weight is the generation Sum of Gen (column C), filtering by the matching FY in column B. I used:

`=SUMPRODUCT(($B$1:$B$43=$H{r})*N($C$1:$C$43)*N($D$1:$D$43))/SUMPRODUCT(($B$1:$B$43=$H{r})*N($C$1:$C$43))`

The `N()` wrapper coerces the header/total text cells to 0 so SUMPRODUCT doesn't return `#VALUE!`. The formulas produce the correct weighted averages (verified independently) and the J7:K7 totals now compute properly.
